purpose: Coverage catalog and representative test cases for every distinct CTRI trial-type, study-type, and study-design combination in the supplied source.

source.registration_coverage_warning: All CTRI numbers in this source are November 2025 registrations. This file does not establish coverage from December 2025 to the present.

interpretation_notes: Study Design is the registry design label and is the primary catalog dimension.
Type of Study mixes modalities, observational forms, free-text Other values, and concatenated multi-select values; raw values are intentionally preserved for parser testing.
A registry design label does not fully specify schedule topology. The system mapping is a static compatibility assessment against schedule archetypes found in backend/schedule_schema.py.
Potential gap means verify explicit semantics; it does not prove the system cannot represent the trial.
Entries labeled Other require record-level or protocol-level classification and must not be treated as a newly discovered design by label alone.
